items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 1.9% in 1985 to 4.6% in 2025 across 105 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

4 of 105 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 13 for salt or chloride; 10 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 105 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 8 of 8 high-need ones have none.
